title: Precipitation Accumulation Peaks
scenario: Find the date when cumulative precipitation for the year exceeded 500mm.
tableSchema: weather_data (city_name VARCHAR, reading_date DATE, precip_mm NUMERIC)
hint: Running total partitioned by city and year.
correctQuery: SELECT city_name, reading_date FROM (SELECT city_name, reading_date, SUM(precip_mm) OVER(PARTITION BY city_name, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM reading_date) ORDER BY reading_date) as cum_precip FROM weather_data) t WHERE cum_precip > 500;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE weather_data (city_name VARCHAR, reading_date DATE, precip_mm NUMERIC);
